mentions.name: Security Level 5 (SL5)
mentions.description: Security Level 5 (SL5) defines nation-state-grade security for frontier AI systems. Its core idea is that model weights or training artifacts that could enable catastrophic harm should be treated like top-tier secrets and secured accordingly.
mentions.problem: Model weights or training artifacts of frontier AI systems could enable catastrophic harm if not secured at the highest level.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Security Level 5 (SL5), which is basically “nation state grade security” for frontier AI systems.
